cues: This grid is the heart of the unit.
A or an: only a singular countable, a book.
Many: only plural countables, many books.
A few and several: plural countables.
A little: uncountables, a little milk.
Each and every: a singular countable, each boy.
Both: two of something, both hands.
And some, any, a lot of and enough go with both plural countables and uncountables.
